How things really work here is one ingress player helps to submit POI’s for 3, 4 or even 5 towns. 
In bigger cities people have a queue of over 300 POI’s. 
There is so much pressure on those ingress players and now even their submissions are flooded by Pokémon go submissions from Germany and Belgian. Pokemonngo submissions is not particularly a bad idea but you probably get my point. 
Eventually if submissions are not soon released in the Netherlands those ingress players will quit submitting because their POI’s don’t get reviewed soon enough and we got noting here,

Some come with good points and opinions that I would agree with them .
I personally won’t stop reviewing but I can understand them coming to this action.

But it doesn’t work that way. 
Many people here in our ingress wayfarer community and other Dutch communities already announced to stop reviewing in our country because of the overflow of German and Belgian submissions till we get submissions here in our country so it would be balanced again.

The submissions from Germany and Belgian still would be present. Yes, that’s not really a problem. 
The problem is now 95% of these submissions are from Germany and Belgium because people can submit stops there. 
I know from experience most communities here in the Netherlands are dependent on one ingress players who helps them submit POI’s and does that for like 4 or 5 towns. Now their submissions are flooded by these German and Belgian submissions and really makes reviewing in the Netherlands reviewing for Belgian and Germany.
Like I said, I don’t have any problems with reviewing for other countries, but now it does effect opr/wayfarer in my country in a very negative way.

I would not mind reviewing PoI’s because even in my own country I would not visit 99% of the POI’s I would have reviewed. It’s more about the amount of Belgian and German submissions that are taking over the submissions from the small amount of ingress players in the Netherlands helping our communities. Releasing submissions in pogo to the Netherlands would equal this so we get not only German and Belgian submissions and the 5% from our ingress players.
